headline: Logitech launches Blue Yeti 2 mic with AI features
summary: Logitech has launched the Blue Yeti 2, the first major successor to its original 2009 USB microphone. The new mic adds an interactive LED display, AI de-noising, 3D voice tracking, and a proximity-based voice sensor, aiming to simplify setup and audio adjustments for content creators.
